From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stage grooming & commit validation — snaglist + review deck routing

Team —

We need a concise sweep of the Hightower Analytics pipeline ahead of next week's leadership review. Goal: lock down stage updates and surface any commits that are at risk for Q1. High level ask:

- Each owner should update the stage column in the attached CSV by EOD Mon (1/12). Use the "snag" column for blockers.
- Marcus, can you run a quick commit-validation pass and drop the output to acct_commit_log_20260111.xlsx? I want a list of deals with close probability changes >= 10%.
- Lauren, I'll need two leadership bullets per deal for anything >$250k (draft doc attached to your mailbox).

Can we also decide who will be the primary owner for the leadership deck routing? I want the final deck in Drive by Thursday 1/15 10am PT so I can assemble the exec packet.

Thanks — small, focused updates please.

Evelyn Hart
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: stage_updates_20260110.csv (spreadsheet stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 11:27:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Stage grooming & commit validation — snaglist + review deck routing

Evelyn —

Attached is the commit-validation export (acct_commit_log_20260111.xlsx). Quick notes from my pass:

- HGT-129 (Hightower Analytics): probability moved from 78% -> 56% after technical Q&A; primary snag is timing on their internal procurement.
- HGT-134: still holds at 92%; legal review in flight, but vendor terms look standard.
- HGT-141: flagged as stale — no contact since 11/20/25, recommended move to "at risk" and add to churn follow-up.

I also populated the snag column in stage_updates_20260110.csv with short reasons and an ETA where available. Small attachment notes: the export includes a comments sheet with the last rep touch timestamp.

If helpful I can pull a short deck-ready slide for HGT-129 that highlights the procurement sequence and options for alternative billing to accelerate close.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

1) Lauren, I'll pull the leadership_bullets_draft_20260113.docx into the master deck by Wed 1/14 6pm PT and convert each qualifying deal into one slide.
2) Marcus, please send the slide for HGT-129 (procurement sequence) by 3pm PT today so I can slot it in. If I don't get it by then I'll include a short note to leadership describing the procurement blocker and recommended mitigation (alternative billing cadence, E&C rapid review).
3) Evelyn, I'll publish the assembled exec packet to Drive and share to the Leadership group (leadership@redwood.com) by Thu 1/15 09:30am PT for final review.

I'll also add a one-slide summary of commit deltas (probability +/-) and a short table of "at risk" deals.
